# Available actions
`BuildStructure(base_location, structure_id)`: Handy convenience building structure behavior. Especially combined with `Mining` and ares built in placement solver. Finds an ideal mining worker, and an available precalculated placement. Then removes worker from mining records and provides a new role.
- `base_location` [Point]: The base location to build near.
- `structure_id` [UnitType]: The structure type we want to build.

`GasBuildingController(to_count)`: Maintain gas building count. Finds an ideal mining worker, and an available geyser. Then removes worker from mining records and provides a new role.
- `to_count` [Integer]: How many gas buildings would we like?.

`ProductionController(army_composition_dict, base_location)`: Handle creating extra production facilities based on an army composition dictionary. This dictionary should be structured the same as the one passed into SpawnController
- `army_composition_dict` [UnitType]: A dictionary detailing how an army composition should be made up. The proportional values should all add up to 1.0, with a priority integer for unit emphasis.
- `base_location` [Point]: The location where production should be built.

`SpawnController(army_composition_dict)`: Handle spawning army compositions.
- `army_composition_dict` [UnitType]: A dictionary detailing how an army composition should be made up. The proportional values should all add up to 1.0, with a priority integer for unit emphasis.

`TechUp(desired_tech, base_location)`: Automatically tech up so desired upgrade/unit can be built.
- `desired_tech` [UnitType]: The desired upgrade or unit type.
- `base_location` [Point]: The main building location to make tech.

`UpgradeCCs(to)`: Upgrade an idle Terran Command Center to an Orbital Command or Planetary Fortress.
- `to` [UnitType]: The desired Command Center upgrade: ORBITALCOMMAND or PLANETARYFORTRESS.

# Available actions
`BuildStructure(base_location, structure_id)`: Handy convenience building structure behavior. Especially combined with `Mining` and ares built in placement solver. Finds an ideal mining worker, and an available precalculated placement. Then removes worker from mining records and provides a new role.
- `base_location` [Point]: The base location to build near.
- `structure_id` [UnitType]: The structure type we want to build.

`GasBuildingController(to_count)`: Maintain gas building count. Finds an ideal mining worker, and an available geyser. Then removes worker from mining records and provides a new role.
- `to_count` [Integer]: How many gas buildings would we like?.

`ProductionController(army_composition_dict, base_location)`: Handle creating extra production facilities based on an army composition dictionary. This dictionary should be structured the same as the one passed into SpawnController
- `army_composition_dict` [UnitType]: A dictionary detailing how an army composition should be made up. The proportional values should all add up to 1.0, with a priority integer for unit emphasis.
- `base_location` [Point]: The location where production should be built.

`SpawnController(army_composition_dict)`: Handle spawning army compositions.
- `army_composition_dict` [UnitType]: A dictionary detailing how an army composition should be made up. The proportional values should all add up to 1.0, with a priority integer for unit emphasis.

`TechUp(desired_tech, base_location)`: Automatically tech up so desired upgrade/unit can be built.
- `desired_tech` [UnitType]: The desired upgrade or unit type.
- `base_location` [Point]: The main building location to make tech.

`UpgradeCCs(to)`: Upgrade an idle Terran Command Center to an Orbital Command or Planetary Fortress.
- `to` [UnitType]: The desired Command Center upgrade: ORBITALCOMMAND or PLANETARYFORTRESS.

# Available actions
`BuildStructure(base_location, structure_id)`: Handy convenience building structure behavior. Especially combined with `Mining` and ares built in placement solver. Finds an ideal mining worker, and an available precalculated placement. Then removes worker from mining records and provides a new role.
- `base_location` [Point]: The base location to build near.
- `structure_id` [UnitType]: The structure type we want to build.

`GasBuildingController(to_count)`: Maintain gas building count. Finds an ideal mining worker, and an available geyser. Then removes worker from mining records and provides a new role.
- `to_count` [Integer]: How many gas buildings would we like?.

`ProductionController(army_composition_dict, base_location)`: Handle creating extra production facilities based on an army composition dictionary. This dictionary should be structured the same as the one passed into SpawnController
- `army_composition_dict` [UnitType]: A dictionary detailing how an army composition should be made up. The proportional values should all add up to 1.0, with a priority integer for unit emphasis.
- `base_location` [Point]: The location where production should be built.

`SpawnController(army_composition_dict)`: Handle spawning army compositions.
- `army_composition_dict` [UnitType]: A dictionary detailing how an army composition should be made up. The proportional values should all add up to 1.0, with a priority integer for unit emphasis.

`TechUp(desired_tech, base_location)`: Automatically tech up so desired upgrade/unit can be built.
- `desired_tech` [UnitType]: The desired upgrade or unit type.
- `base_location` [Point]: The main building location to make tech.

`UpgradeCCs(to)`: Upgrade an idle Terran Command Center to an Orbital Command or Planetary Fortress.
- `to` [UnitType]: The desired Command Center upgrade: ORBITALCOMMAND or PLANETARYFORTRESS.

# Available actions
`BuildStructure(base_location, structure_id)`: Handy convenience building structure behavior. Especially combined with `Mining` and ares built in placement solver. Finds an ideal mining worker, and an available precalculated placement. Then removes worker from mining records and provides a new role.
- `base_location` [Point]: The base location to build near.
- `structure_id` [UnitType]: The structure type we want to build.

`GasBuildingController(to_count)`: Maintain gas building count. Finds an ideal mining worker, and an available geyser. Then removes worker from mining records and provides a new role.
- `to_count` [Integer]: How many gas buildings would we like?.

`ProductionController(army_composition_dict, base_location)`: Handle creating extra production facilities based on an army composition dictionary. This dictionary should be structured the same as the one passed into SpawnController
- `army_composition_dict` [UnitType]: A dictionary detailing how an army composition should be made up. The proportional values should all add up to 1.0, with a priority integer for unit emphasis.
- `base_location` [Point]: The location where production should be built.

`SpawnController(army_composition_dict)`: Handle spawning army compositions.
- `army_composition_dict` [UnitType]: A dictionary detailing how an army composition should be made up. The proportional values should all add up to 1.0, with a priority integer for unit emphasis.

`TechUp(desired_tech, base_location)`: Automatically tech up so desired upgrade/unit can be built.
- `desired_tech` [UnitType]: The desired upgrade or unit type.
- `base_location` [Point]: The main building location to make tech.

`UpgradeCCs(to)`: Upgrade an idle Terran Command Center to an Orbital Command or Planetary Fortress.
- `to` [UnitType]: The desired Command Center upgrade: ORBITALCOMMAND or PLANETARYFORTRESS.

- `[Point]`: Landmark (`main`, `natural`, `enemy_main`) or `{"x": number, "y": number}`.
- `[UnitType]`: Exact SC2 unit or structure name, e.g. `STARPORT`.

# Available actions
`BuildStructure(base_location, structure_id)`: Handy convenience building structure behavior. Especially combined with `Mining` and ares built in placement solver. Finds an ideal mining worker, and an available precalculated placement. Then removes worker from mining records and provides a new role.
- `base_location` [Point]: The base location to build near.
- `structure_id` [UnitType]: The structure type we want to build.

`GasBuildingController(to_count)`: Maintain gas building count. Finds an ideal mining worker, and an available geyser. Then removes worker from mining records and provides a new role.
- `to_count` [Integer]: How many gas buildings would we like?.

`ProductionController(army_composition_dict, base_location)`: Handle creating extra production facilities based on an army composition dictionary. This dictionary should be structured the same as the one passed into SpawnController
- `army_composition_dict` [UnitType]: A dictionary detailing how an army composition should be made up. The proportional values should all add up to 1.0, with a priority integer for unit emphasis.
- `base_location` [Point]: The location where production should be built.

`SpawnController(army_composition_dict)`: Handle spawning army compositions.
- `army_composition_dict` [UnitType]: A dictionary detailing how an army composition should be made up. The proportional values should all add up to 1.0, with a priority integer for unit emphasis.

`TechUp(desired_tech, base_location)`: Automatically tech up so desired upgrade/unit can be built.
- `desired_tech` [UnitType]: The desired upgrade or unit type.
- `base_location` [Point]: The main building location to make tech.

`UpgradeCCs(to)`: Upgrade an idle Terran Command Center to an Orbital Command or Planetary Fortress.
- `to` [UnitType]: The desired Command Center upgrade: ORBITALCOMMAND or PLANETARYFORTRESS.

Finds an ideal mining worker, and an available precalculated placement. Then removes worker from mining records and provides a new role.
- `base_location` [Point]: The base location to build near.
- `structure_id` [UnitType]: The structure type we want to build.

`GasBuildingController(to_count)`: Maintain gas building count. Finds an ideal mining worker, and an available geyser. Then removes worker from mining records and provides a new role.
- `to_count` [Integer]: How many gas buildings would we like?.

`ProductionController(army_composition_dict, base_location)`: Handle creating extra production facilities based on an army composition dictionary. This dictionary should be structured the same as the one passed into SpawnController
- `army_composition_dict` [UnitType]: A dictionary detailing how an army composition should be made up. The proportional values should all add up to 1.0, with a priority integer for unit emphasis.
- `base_location` [Point]: The location where production should be built.

`SpawnController(army_composition_dict)`: Handle spawning army compositions.
- `army_composition_dict` [UnitType]: A dictionary detailing how an army composition should be made up. The proportional values should all add up to 1.0, with a priority integer for unit emphasis.

`TechUp(desired_tech, base_location)`: Automatically tech up so desired upgrade/unit can be built.
- `desired_tech` [UnitType]: The desired upgrade or unit type.
- `base_location` [Point]: The main building location to make tech.

`UpgradeCCs(to)`: Upgrade an idle Terran Command Center to an Orbital Command or Planetary Fortress.
- `to` [UnitType]: The desired Command Center upgrade: ORBITALCOMMAND or PLANETARYFORTRESS.

# Available actions
`BuildStructure(base_location, structure_id)`: Handy convenience building structure behavior. Especially combined with `Mining` and ares built in placement solver. Finds an ideal mining worker, and an available precalculated placement. Then removes worker from mining records and provides a new role.
- `base_location` [Point]: The base location to build near.
- `structure_id` [UnitType]: The structure type we want to build.

`GasBuildingController(to_count)`: Maintain gas building count. Finds an ideal mining worker, and an available geyser. Then removes worker from mining records and provides a new role.
- `to_count` [Integer]: How many gas buildings would we like?.

`ProductionController(army_composition_dict, base_location)`: Handle creating extra production facilities based on an army composition dictionary. This dictionary should be structured the same as the one passed into SpawnController
- `army_composition_dict` [UnitType]: A dictionary detailing how an army composition should be made up. The proportional values should all add up to 1.0, with a priority integer for unit emphasis.
- `base_location` [Point]: The location where production should be built.

`SpawnController(army_composition_dict)`: Handle spawning army compositions.
- `army_composition_dict` [UnitType]: A dictionary detailing how an army composition should be made up. The proportional values should all add up to 1.0, with a priority integer for unit emphasis.

`TechUp(desired_tech, base_location)`: Automatically tech up so desired upgrade/unit can be built.
- `desired_tech` [UnitType]: The desired upgrade or unit type.
- `base_location` [Point]: The main building location to make tech.

`UpgradeCCs(to)`: Upgrade an idle Terran Command Center to an Orbital Command or Planetary Fortress.
- `to` [UnitType]: The desired Command Center upgrade: ORBITALCOMMAND or PLANETARYFORTRESS.

`BuildStructure(base_location, structure_id)`: Handy convenience building structure behavior. Especially combined with `Mining` and ares built in placement solver. - `base_location` [Point]: The base location to build near.
- `structure_id` [UnitType]: The structure type we want to build.

`GasBuildingController(to_count)`: Maintain gas building count. Finds an ideal mining worker, and an available geyser. Then removes worker from mining records and provides a new role.
- `to_count` [Integer]: How many gas buildings would we like?.

`ProductionController(army_composition_dict, base_location)`: Handle creating extra production facilities based on an army composition dictionary. This dictionary should be structured the same as the one passed into SpawnController
- `army_composition_dict` [UnitType]: A dictionary detailing how an army composition should be made up. The proportional values should all add up to 1.0, with a priority integer for unit emphasis.
- `base_location` [Point]: The location where production should be built.

`SpawnController(army_composition_dict)`: Handle spawning army compositions.
- `army_composition_dict` [UnitType]: A dictionary detailing how an army composition should be made up. The proportional values should all add up to 1.0, with a priority integer for unit emphasis.

`TechUp(desired_tech, base_location)`: Automatically tech up so desired upgrade/unit can be built.
- `desired_tech` [UnitType]: The desired upgrade or unit type.
- `base_location` [Point]: The main building location to make tech.

`UpgradeCCs(to)`: Upgrade an idle Terran Command Center to an Orbital Command or Planetary Fortress.
- `to` [UnitType]: The desired Command Center upgrade: ORBITALCOMMAND or PLANETARYFORTRESS.
